cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top

cues.headline: Rapid!

cues.headline: So close!
cues.body: Ivo Wexley should have scored: chances like that go in 37% of the time.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers turn the screw
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are calling the shots now: leaving Corrin Bay just 8.0 passes per defensive action and playing 6 progressive passes in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: Corrin Bay have switched it up
cues.body: New shape for Corrin Bay on the ball: a 4-3-3 now, after a 3-2-5.

cues.headline: GOAL! Eloy Garrow!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 1–0 Corrin Bay. It had been coming: Elmstead Wanderers were in control.

cues.headline: Corrin Bay have the momentum
cues.body: The tide has turned: Corrin Bay are the ones carrying the threat now, 0.19 to 0.05 in the last 5 minutes. Just what Corrin Bay need while they're behind.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are going over the top
cues.body: Corrin Bay are pressing, so Elmstead Wanderers are launching it: 18% of their passes are long balls now.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 4.8 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Corrin Bay are on top
cues.body: Corrin Bay are on top: leaving Elmstead Wanderers just 3.3 passes per defensive action and winning the ball back in the opposition half 2 times in the last 5 minutes. Just what Corrin Bay need while they're behind.

cues.headline: Rafe Lindqvist scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 1–1 Corrin Bay. It had been coming: Corrin Bay were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: Danger through the middle
cues.body: Corrin Bay are getting joy through the middle: 90% of their dangerous moves in the last 5 minutes went that way.

cues.headline: Tired legs at Elmstead Wanderers
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are slowing down: 64 m a minute per player lately, from 86 m earlier on. With the score level, Corrin Bay will smell a chance.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 71%, Corrin Bay 29%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers have taken over
cues.body: The game is going Elmstead Wanderers's way: forcing Corrin Bay into 3 losses in their own half, recovering the ball 2 times in the final third and winning the ball back in the opposition half 2 times in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: A tactical tweak from Corrin Bay
cues.body: Corrin Bay look different on the ball: a 4-3-3 now, where they were a 3-2-5.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 6.4 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: Corrin Bay are hunting the ball
cues.body: Corrin Bay keep winning it back high up the pitch: 9 times in the last 5 minutes. Elmstead Wanderers can't settle.

cues.headline: Danger through the middle
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are getting joy through the middle: 96% of their dangerous moves in the last 5 minutes went that way.

cues.headline: Corrin Bay turn the screw
cues.body: Corrin Bay are calling the shots now: leaving Elmstead Wanderers just 1.6 passes per defensive action, forcing Elmstead Wanderers into 4 losses in their own half and winning the ball back in the opposition half 4 times in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: It's in! Fenn Jessop!
cues.body: Fenn Jessop finds the net for Corrin Bay: Elmstead Wanderers 1–2 Corrin Bay. It had been coming: Corrin Bay were in control. It came 10 seconds after Corrin Bay won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers keep losing it at the back
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers have given the ball away 6 times in their own half in the last 5 minutes. Dangerous!

recap.headline: Full time: Elmstead Wanderers 1–2 Corrin Bay
recap.summary: A deserved win for Corrin Bay.
